name: L293D
full_name: Quadruple Half-H Driver with Clamp Diodes (Push-Pull Four Channel Driver)
description: Quadruple high-current half-H driver, i.e. two full H-bridges, with totem-pole push-pull outputs and integrated output clamp diodes for inductive transient suppression. Provides bidirectional drive currents up to 600mA per channel (1.2A peak) at motor supply voltages from 4.5V to 36V. A separate logic supply VCC1 (5V) powers the inputs; channels are enabled in pairs by 1,2EN and 3,4EN. Drives DC motors, bipolar stepper motors, relays and solenoids directly from microcontroller logic.

typical_application: Driving one bipolar stepper or two small DC motors bidirectionally from an Arduino, using the two full bridges.
gotchas: L293D has internal output clamp diodes; the plain L293 does NOT and needs external flyback diodes
two separate supplies: VCC1 (pin 16, 5V logic) and VCC2 (pin 8, 4.5-36V motor power)
drivers enable in pairs via 1,2EN and 3,4EN, not individually
pins 4,5,12,13 are all ground and double as the heat sink - connect to a copper ground plane
outputs are push-pull totem-pole, not open-collector
